project_name: ECP Project Management & Lead Tracking System
archetype_description: High-density command center UI tailored for solar energy ERP operations. Emphasizes operational clarity, status visibility, SLA tracking, minimal friction data entry, and zero-ambiguity workflow routing across 7 distinct organizational roles.

layout_rules: Every major page must display a clear Header Bar with Active Role Indicator, Role Switcher for testing, User Info, and Dark Mode Toggle.
The top section of every role dashboard must feature Clickable Metric Counter Cards that act as immediate filter toggles for data tables below.
CURRENT STATUS, CURRENT TEAM, CURRENT PERSON, and NEXT ACTION must be highlighted in prominent visual highlight boxes on all detail views.
Use subgrid and h-full on direct grid children to eliminate jagged card bottoms.
Ensure all card borders have internal padding (min p-4) to avoid edge text collision.

component_guidelines.stage_stepper: Horizontal step bar on desktop and compact stepper card on mobile. Completed stages marked emerald green with checkmark icon; current active stage highlighted in CSPDCL blue with pulse glow; upcoming stages muted gray. Displays assigned team name and SLA countdown directly under each step node.
component_guidelines.status_badges: Always include status_badges classes with uppercase label, border, and clear dot indicator. DELAYED status badge MUST include pulse animation.
component_guidelines.counter_cards: Interactive metric boxes with large bold metric number (text-3xl font-black), icon, change indicator, and clear border. Clicking toggles data table filter for that specific bucket.
component_guidelines.data_tables: Sticky table header, clear row hover state (hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50), inline action buttons, searchable filter bar, density switch, and explicit column for 'Current Team / Person' and 'Next Required Action'.
component_guidelines.action_modals: Focused modal dialogs for Lead 5-actions and Stage updates. Must enforce minimal required inputs (e.g. date picker, note text area, assignment dropdown) so data entry takes under 15 seconds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read /app/design_guidelines.json completely before writing frontend code.

Implement a dedicated demo Role Switcher on the main navigation bar so test users and evaluators can instantly jump between Owner, Manager, Lead Team, Registration, Accounts, Dispatch, and Installation views.
Ensure every table item displays clear derived badges like 'Payment Blocked', 'Ready for Dispatch', 'Dispatch In Process', or 'DELAYED'.
Maintain high visual density with crisp borders, clear SLAs in hours/days, and immediate single-click action modals.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes per the specified testing_attributes rules.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop centered layouts; build high-density, structured command dashboards.
Use layered contrast with 1px slate borders and zero text truncation on critical IDs/Names.
Ensure hover, focus, and active states have explicit text color overrides.
Use sonner for instant toast feedback when status/lead transitions occur.
Maintain responsive grid layouts with mobile-first breakpoints.
